name: Deep Field
description: The ringworld's outer rim has been torn open to vacuum. The operative must cross the deep-field maintenance platforms while maintaining oxygen integrity. Alien snipers and seeker bots occupy the catwalks.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Hull breach detected. Outer rim is exposed to vacuum. Your suit can handle six minutes. Don't waste them.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Seal confirmed. The ring's atmosphere is stable in this sector. The aliens are using the breach as a hunting ground.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Platforms clear. I'm reading three sniper signatures on the catwalks ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Snipers eliminated. Their targeting data is being uploaded to the spire. We need to move before the next wave arrives.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Airlock reached. Atmosphere restored. Welcome back inside the ring.

easter_eggs.name: CE Release Bug
easter_eggs.description: Fourth-wall break: the game acknowledges it is a build with known issues.
